name: OSME Trevor Poyser Species Conservation Fund

funder.name: Ornithological Society of the Middle East, the Caucasus and Central Asia (OSME)

summary: A single £5,000 award for a primarily field-based research and monitoring project on a globally threatened bird species in the OSME region; the project leader must be a national of the project country.

calls.label: Call with 1 December deadline
calls.recurring: Applications are due by 1 December, for projects starting the following calendar year.
calls.note: The page gives the 1 December deadline without a year.

status.quote: Applications are considered once a year, and must be submitted on the standard application form.

recurring.quote: applications must be submitted by the 1st December for projects that must start during the following calendar year.

access.quote: Applications are considered once a year, and must be submitted on the standard application form.

window.quote: The deadline is the 1st December and applicants will usually be notified by the 31st December.

amount.quote: One award of £5000 is made each year

geography.quote: aimed specifically at individual species research and conservation projects within the OSME region
